# Erag Open-Source Packages — Full Documentation Reference

> Author: Er Amit Gupta
> Website: https://erag.in/
> GitHub: https://github.com/eramitgupta

---

## 1. Laravel Disposable Email
- **URL**: https://erag.in/laravel-disposable-email/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/eramitgupta/laravel-disposable-email
- **Description**: Block disposable, fake, and temporary burner email addresses in Laravel. Includes built-in validation rules, automatic remote blacklist syncing, DNS MX checks, and high-performance cache drivers.
- **Install**:
  ```bash
  composer require erag/laravel-disposable-email
  php artisan disposable:sync
  ```
- **Usage**:
  ```php
  $request->validate([
      'email' => ['required', 'email', 'disposable'],
  ]);
  ```

---

## 2. Laravel Inertia Toast
- **URL**: https://erag.in/laravel-inertia-toast/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/eramitgupta/laravel-inertia-toast
- **Description**: Send flash toast alerts and confirmation dialog modals directly from Laravel controllers to Inertia.js (Vue 3 and React) with zero boilerplate.
- **Install**:
  ```bash
  composer require erag/laravel-inertia-toast
  npm install @erag/laravel-inertia-toast
  ```
- **Laravel Controller Usage**:
  ```php
  return redirect()->back()->withToast('success', 'Profile updated successfully!');
  ```

---

## 3. Laravel Lang Sync Inertia
- **URL**: https://erag.in/laravel-lang-sync-inertia/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/eramitgupta/laravel-lang-sync-inertia
- **Description**: Automatically export and sync Laravel PHP language translation files to Inertia.js frontends with Vue 3, React, and Svelte i18n helpers.
- **Install**:
  ```bash
  composer require erag/laravel-lang-sync-inertia
  php artisan lang:sync
  ```
- **Frontend Usage (Vue / React / Svelte)**:
  ```js
  import { __, trans } from 'laravel-lang-sync-inertia';
  __('messages.welcome', { name: 'User' });
  ```

---

## 4. Phone Number Vue
- **URL**: https://erag.in/phone-number-vue/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/eramitgupta/phone-number-vue
- **Description**: Headless Vue 3 composable (`usePhoneNumber`) for country-aware phone input, dial codes, auto formatting, and validation without external heavy masking libraries.
- **Install**:
  ```bash
  npm install @erag/phone-number-vue
  ```
- **Usage**:
  ```vue
  <script setup>
  import { usePhoneNumber } from '@erag/phone-number-vue';
  const { phone, country, formattedPhone, isValid, handleInput } = usePhoneNumber({ defaultCountry: 'IN' });
  </script>
  ```

---

## 5. Phone Number React
- **URL**: https://erag.in/phone-number-react/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/eramitgupta/phone-number-react
- **Description**: Headless React hook (`usePhoneNumber`) for country-aware phone input, dial codes, auto formatting, and validation in React 18 and 19.
- **Install**:
  ```bash
  npm install @erag/phone-number-react
  ```
- **Usage**:
  ```jsx
  import { usePhoneNumber } from '@erag/phone-number-react';
  const { phone, country, formattedPhone, isValid, handleInput } = usePhoneNumber({ defaultCountry: 'US' });
  ```

---

## 6. Laravel PWA
- **URL**: https://erag.in/laravel-pwa/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/eramitgupta/laravel-pwa
- **Description**: Transform Laravel applications into Progressive Web Apps (PWA) with automatic web manifest generation, service worker registration, custom install prompts, and dynamic logo uploads.
- **Install**:
  ```bash
  composer require erag/laravel-pwa
  php artisan pwa:install
  ```
- **Blade Directive**:
  ```blade
  @pwa
  ```

---

## 7. Vue Toastification
- **URL**: https://erag.in/vue-toastification/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/eramitgupta/vue-toastification
- **Description**: Lightweight, high-performance toast notifications and promise-based confirmation modals for Vue 3 with smooth Apple-style animations and Composition API support.
- **Install**:
  ```bash
  npm install @erag/vue-toastification
  ```
- **Usage**:
  ```vue
  <script setup>
  import { useToast } from '@erag/vue-toastification';
  const toast = useToast();
  toast.success('Operation completed successfully!');
  </script>
  ```

---

## 8. Text Editor Vue
- **URL**: https://erag.in/text-editor-vue/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/eramitgupta/text-editor-vue
- **Description**: A modern, dependency-free Vue 3 rich text editor (WYSIWYG) built with native browser APIs. Features mentions (@), merge tags ({{), templates, image uploads, tables, HTML editing, and customizable menubars.
- **Install**:
  ```bash
  npm install @erag/text-editor-vue
  ```
- **Usage**:
  ```vue
  <script setup>
  import { ref } from 'vue';
  import { Editor } from '@erag/text-editor-vue';
  import '@erag/text-editor-vue/dist/style.css';
  const content = ref('<p>Hello World</p>');
  </script>
  <template>
    <Editor v-model="content" />
  </template>
  ```
